name: alpha-release-scripts
description: Alpha Release Gate build/verification scripts for the offline distribution package. The only runtime dependency is Playwright, pinned to the same version tools/design_notes/package.json uses, needed only to drive the real vendored libraries (Cytoscape.js/xlsx/TinySegmenter) and the completed dist/ build in a real browser for tools/release/alpha_release_runtime_smoke_verification.js and later offline E2E verification. tools/release/build_alpha_release.js itself has no dependencies at all (plain Node fs/path/crypto) and runs fully offline. Run npm ci in this directory before running the Playwright-based scripts.
